description: Same-game NFL prop pairs this week whose legs move together (a QB's passing yards with a teammate's receiving yards or catches, one receiver's catches with his yards): our chance both overs hit priced together with the correlation measured on every season since 2019, beside the two chances multiplied, and our chance and the market's on each leg. Strongest first; `favoured` marks a pair whose two overs we both favour at or above the market. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

favoured_only.description: Only pairs whose two overs we both favour.

game_id.description: One NFL game, by the game_id that nfl_games returns, such as 2026_11_IND_HOU. Every game this week when left out.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.
